reasoning: The only voting report marked the package as inconclusive solely due to API errors when reviewing several .desktop files. However, .desktop files are declarative metadata installed to /usr/share/applications and do not execute during makepkg or .install hooks. The actual packaging files (PKGBUILD, .install, patches, udev rules) were reviewed and found to be standard, benign AUR packaging for the official Segger J-Link binary blob. The advisory report failed to parse the PKGBUILD and is excluded from the vote. There is no evidence of AUR injection.
coverage_issues: qwen3-235b failed to review several .desktop files due to HTTP 400 API errors, resulting in an inconclusive overall verdict.
openrouter/free (advisory) failed to parse the PKGBUILD response.
learnings: The audit tool should not allow failures on non-executable, non-build-time files (like .desktop files) to force an inconclusive verdict. These files should be deprioritized or safely skipped if they fail, as they pose no AUR injection risk.
Ensure the full PKGBUILD audit (including build/package functions) is explicitly logged and verified, rather than just the initial parse-time (--printsrcinfo) safety check.
